description: This file defines the 'DeleteCatalogItemResponse' class, which is a response model used in the Catalog Item Delete Endpoint within the Public API of the eShop Web project. The class inherits from 'BaseResponse' and includes a property to indicate the status of the deletion.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemResponse
classes.description: Represents the response returned after a catalog item deletion operation, including status information.
